hebrewText: אֵין קֹרֵ֣א בְ/צֶ֔דֶק וְ/אֵ֥ין נִשְׁפָּ֖ט בֶּ/אֱמוּנָ֑ה בָּט֤וֹחַ עַל תֹּ֨הוּ֙ וְ/דַבֶּר שָׁ֔וְא הָר֥וֹ עָמָ֖ל וְ/הוֹלֵ֥יד אָֽוֶן

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.bdb: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.

tokens.bdb: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
tokens.kjv: [idiom] even, ([idiom] that which is altogether) just(-ice), (un-)right(-eous) (cause, -ly, -ness).

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.bdb: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] avenge, [idiom] that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), [idiom] needs, plead, reason, rule.

tokens.bdb: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.kjv: faith(-ful, -ly, -ness, (man)), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.enLiteralWord: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.explanation: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.explanationEn: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity

tokens.bdb: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
tokens.kjv: be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: a desolation (of surface), i.e. desert; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain
tokens.kjv: confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste, wilderness.

tokens.bdb: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, [idiom] well, [idiom] work.

tokens.bdb: evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain)
to be (or become) pregnant, conceive (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: been, be with child, conceive, progenitor.

tokens.bdb: toil, i.e. wearing effort; hence, worry, wheth. of body or mind
tokens.kjv: grievance(-vousness), iniquity, labour, mischief, miserable(-sery), pain(-ful), perverseness, sorrow, toil, travail, trouble, wearisome, wickedness.

tokens.bdb: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
tokens.kjv: bear, beget, birth(-day), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail(-eth, -ing woman).

tokens.bdb: strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol
tokens.kjv: affliction, evil, false, idol, iniquity, mischief, mourners(-ing), naught, sorrow, unjust, unrighteous, vain, vanity, wicked(-ness). Compare H369 (אַיִן).
